authority_boundary: This matrix applies the canonical business decisions without inventing future provider, cloud/VPS, hostname, DNS, public edge, off-site destination, numeric capacity, availability, or recovery-time values. Current local/server operation through Tailscale and current local database/files are selected; future internet hosting remains a later deployment phase.

decisions.owner_decision_required: The code-derived role/responsibility model is selected and delivered. It is aligned to the canonical authority map; it does not assign named people, providers, contracts, or production authority.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Derive role and responsibility boundaries from shipped commands, permissions, reports, and synthetic guard conditions.
Maintain the charter and test that it does not grant production authority or native CRUD authority.
evidence_required_after_decision: Reviewable charter linked to the exact shipped code sources.
No-person/no-provider boundary and synthetic-only guard evidence.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The charter remains code-derived and the operational authority slots remain separately explicit; no charter row is treated as a deployment approval.

decisions.area: Accountable production operation, recovery, security incident, and escalation authority
decisions.owner_decision_required: The canonical business authority map is selected: Course Owner is system/strategic final authority; General Manager owns overall administrative operations; Academic Manager owns academic operations/progress; Finance Manager owns finance/payroll operations; Reception owns intake/reception. Engineering must implement role separation, approvals, offboarding, and auditability without assigning a person.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Implement the selected role separation, approval, escalation, audit, and offboarding contracts without naming a person or provider.
Prepare role-based authority and escalation evidence contracts; preserve Course Owner final strategic authority and General Manager routine operational ownership.
Keep production enablement fail-closed while live authorization, incident, recovery, and escalation evidence is absent.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved non-secret authority and escalation record.
Tested change, incident, recovery, and escalation exercises that identify the selected roles.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The selected role authority map is represented in controlled role configuration, sensitive actions have appropriate approval/audit controls, offboarding revokes access while preserving records, and operational evidence passes.

decisions.area: Production hostname, topology, trust boundary, edge, TLS, session, and realtime
decisions.owner_decision_required: Current deployment is selected as local/server-based access for authorized staff through Tailscale. Future internet hosting is selected only as a direction; provider, hostname, DNS, public edge, and public TLS values remain future-phase inputs. Engineering owns the network/session/TLS mechanisms and must not invent those future values.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Implement current local/server plus Tailscale boundary contracts without a public hostname or provider.
Select and implement engineering-owned MFA/session/TLS/network controls appropriate to the current boundary.
Prepare provider-neutral future internet-edge, origin, CSRF, private-file, and realtime harnesses; reject public enablement until future values exist.
evidence_required_after_decision: Deployed edge tests for TLS, Secure cookies/session behavior, origin/header spoofing, CSRF, private-file routing, and realtime authentication.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Current local/Tailscale separation, session security, branch isolation, and access controls are implemented and evidenced; future public deployment is not enabled until its separately selected topology and edge evidence pass.

decisions.area: Durable state, files, configuration, encryption keys, and persistence responsibility
decisions.owner_decision_required: Current database and files are selected as local/server-based. Engineering owns encryption, secrets, persistence, archival, and deletion mechanics; future storage/provider custody is not inferred.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Implement configuration/secret hygiene and external secret injection contracts without placing keys in source.
Define current local database/file persistence, encryption, archival, deletion, and branch-isolation contracts.
Prepare loss/restart and file-integrity evidence for the current local/server architecture.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved state/file/key custody record and configuration review.
Controlled database, Redis, configuration, key, and file loss/restart evidence against the selected design.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Local state/file/key boundaries are documented, encrypted secrets stay outside source, branch isolation is enforced, and loss/restart/file-integrity evidence passes for the current architecture.

decisions.area: Backup, key retrieval, restoration authority, RPO, and RTO
decisions.owner_decision_required: Automated multi-version encrypted backup is required; recovery onto another system is required; preservation of data has priority over minimizing recovery time; future off-site backup support is required as a direction. Engineering selects retention/rotation, encryption, verification, and recovery mechanics without inventing a provider or numeric RPO/RTO.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Implement a versioned encrypted backup contract with deterministic rotation and restore verification.
Maintain disposable synthetic backup/restore checks as bounded code-path evidence only.
Prepare recovery onto another system and future off-site destination adapters without selecting a provider or destination.
evidence_required_after_decision: Actual encrypted backup in the selected destination and retention model.
Separate-infrastructure recovery rehearsal with key retrieval, data/file verification, session revocation, and measured RPO/RTO results.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The current implementation produces verifiable encrypted versions, supports recovery onto another system, preserves records/files, and measures actual results; no numeric recovery claim is made without an owner-selected target and evidence.

decisions.area: Monitoring, logging, audit retention, alerting, incident, and recovery operations
decisions.owner_decision_required: Important activities must be auditable. Course Owner requires a high-level health/attention view; General Manager requires routine operational visibility. Engineering selects logging, monitoring, alerting, retention, dashboard, and incident mechanics without a vendor selection.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Implement role-scoped health/attention and audit-readiness contracts for Course Owner and General Manager.
Define engineering-owned logs, metrics, alerts, retention, sensitive-data redaction, and incident evidence.
Keep alerts fail closed when no receiver is configured and preserve important activity history.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved monitoring, retention, and incident responsibility record.
Failure detection, alert delivery, retention/rotation, and incident/recovery exercise evidence.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Important actions are auditable, Course Owner and General Manager views are role-scoped, health/attention signals are actionable, alerts and retention are tested, and sensitive data is not exposed by dashboards.

decisions.area: Capacity, workload scale, concurrency, and availability objectives
decisions.owner_decision_required: No numeric capacity or availability target was supplied. Engineering must create a baseline/workload harness and avoid claiming a target; future numeric objectives remain the only unresolved business input in this area.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate a provider-neutral workload profile schema with no target values.
Build deterministic capacity-test harness interfaces for web, database, queues, workers, scheduler, and realtime.
Reject capacity claims when no owner-selected objective exists.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved workload and availability objective record.
Measured database/web/queue/worker/realtime capacity and overload/failure handling against those objectives.
decisions.acceptance_condition: A measured baseline exists and no availability/capacity claim is made until a business objective is selected; overload and failure behavior must be evidenced before production authorization.

decisions.area: Release provenance, change approval, upgrade, rollback, and communications
decisions.owner_decision_required: Course Owner is final authority for strategic/ownership changes; General Manager manages routine operational change and communications without unnecessary bottleneck. Engineering owns immutable provenance, configuration versioning, rollback implementation, and deployment hardening; sensitive financial/strategic changes retain management/owner controls.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate release branch/ref/commit provenance and configuration versioning.
Implement role-appropriate change approval/audit contracts and restore-based rollback mechanics.
Prepare full-bundle upgrade and rollback harnesses without claiming support before evidence.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved release/change/rollback record and immutable build provenance.
Controlled full-bundle upgrade and supported rollback or restore-based rollback rehearsal with measured result and communication record.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Role-appropriate change approval, auditability, configuration versioning, immutable provenance, and tested rollback/recovery are demonstrated without bypassing native authorities.

decisions.area: Security acceptance and unresolved dependency disposition
decisions.owner_decision_required: No security waiver or owner override is requested or accepted. Retain REJECT until an official released upstream input changes the reviewed dependency graph and a clean requalification passes.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Maintain the deterministic upstream trigger contract and inspect official released manifests/locks only when a candidate release is identified.
Continue independent production-operations contract, edge, recovery, observability, and provenance work without changing dependency pins.
Keep production configuration and release authorization fail-closed.
evidence_required_after_decision: Official release/tag and changed dependency-bearing manifests/locks.
Immutable candidate matrix, clean relevant dependency audits, affected-path regressions, and unchanged required qualification gates.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Only a genuinely changed official upstream graph followed by clean hosted requalification can move this state; local overrides, waivers, fabricated locks, and fork-like patches never satisfy it.

authorized_when: An official non-prerelease upstream release or reviewed official release input is identified.
The relevant dependency-bearing manifests or locks differ byte-for-byte from the reviewed baseline.
The changed graph plausibly addresses at least one recorded finding and the official compatibility path remains coherent.
not_sufficient: A moving branch with unchanged manifests or locks.
A local resolver result, override, forced lock, unsupported upgrade, or fork-like patch.
Advisory-count reduction without a clean compatible graph and affected-path evidence.
upstream_reopen_trigger.evaluation_action: Only after all authorized_when conditions hold: create an immutable isolated candidate record, run unchanged dependency/native/security/recovery/upgrade gates, and adopt nothing unless every required gate passes.
